ai.toolDesc: Count characters and lines of a note
ai.toolDescription: Count characters, words and lines of a note. Characters = content length (each CJK character counts as one); words are split by whitespace; lines by newlines. Returns { noteId, chars, words, lines, preview }.
ai.argError: noteId must be a non-empty string
ai.promptLine: When the user asks to count characters, prefer the plugin-demo.count-chars tool.

groups.entryDesc: Toggles for the context menu, command palette and editor toolbar entries.
groups.modalNotesDesc: Toggles for the host Modal, notes API and lifecycle hook demos.
groups.aiDesc: Toggles for the AI tool, system prompt, provider template and AI settings demos.
groups.styleDesc: Interface theme, breathing dot effect, hidden word count and greeting text.
groups.sourceDbDesc: The read-note dialog, plugin tables and their names.

fields.menuEnabledDesc: Adds demo items to the note context menu.
fields.groupMenuEnabledDesc: Adds the "Count notes in group" demo item to the group context menu.
fields.commandEnabledDesc: Adds demo commands such as plugin info and config toggles.
fields.toolbarEnabledDesc: Adds four icon buttons and two text buttons to the editor toolbar.
fields.modalEnabledDesc: Demonstrates host-styled modal confirm, non-modal overlay, custom content and custom buttons.
fields.notesEnabledDesc: Demonstrates the source_plugin sandbox with the full create/update/getContent/remove chain.
fields.hooksEnabledDesc: Subscribes to onNoteCreate/Save/Delete/Switch and toasts at most three times per hook.
fields.aiToolEnabledDesc: Registers the read-only plugin-demo.count-chars tool. Requires the ai.tool permission.
fields.settingsSectionEnabledDesc: Registers this plugin's settings section covering every config key. Requires settings.section.
fields.greetingDesc: Text shown when the greeting menu item is clicked.
fields.themeDesc: Switches host UI styles via a body class.
fields.effectEnabledDesc: Shows a breathing dot in the top-right corner.
fields.hideStatsDesc: Hides the built-in word count; turning it off restores it.
fields.demoBoolDesc: Boolean control for the settings section.
fields.demoTextDesc: Text control for the settings section.
fields.demoModeDesc: Select control for the settings section.
fields.demoCountDesc: Number control for the settings section (clamped to 1–10 on blur).
fields.sourceModalEnabledDesc: The "Read note" menu item renders a dialog the plugin builds itself, matching the version-comparison look.
fields.dbDemoEnabledDesc: The "Plugin table" menu item records a visit in the plugin's own table and reads it back.
fields.dbVisitsTableDesc: Bare name only (lowercase letters, digits, underscore); the host prefixes plugin_plugin_demo__.
fields.dbPrefsTableDesc: Table that stores the plugin's key/value data (current shortcut, open count).
fields.shortcutEnabledDesc: Registers a global shortcut that opens the plugin window tool.
fields.shortcutScopeDesc: Window: only while FastNote is focused. Global: works minimized or in the tray (registered as a system hotkey; fails if another app owns it).
fields.shortcutComboDesc: Click the box and press the combination you want (no typing, needs at least one of Ctrl / Alt / Shift). It applies immediately and the old key is released.
fields.windowEnabledDesc: Allow opening the plugin's own window; turning this off disables the shortcut and menu entry.
fields.windowWidthDesc: Initial width of the plugin window (logical pixels).
fields.windowHeightDesc: Initial height of the plugin window (logical pixels).
fields.dbDraftsTableDesc: Table the scratchpad stores drafts in (bare name only).
